owner: C coordinates website-admitted canonical rows; A executes protected joins; B supplies exact existing adapters and verifies permitted outputs
namespace: Website numeric ESPN IDs are not automatically B NFL/GSIS IDs. No fuzzy-name join. A permitted exact ordinal bridge is valid only for its original bound case contract, not automatically this archive.
input_boundary: Existing frozen prediction lookup only. Never feed retained actual/status/postgame profile fields to forecast worker; query allowlist is explicit. No recursive ZIP load. Earlier training labels remain permitted under declared availability.

products.points: Use the exact saved output field and history/query origin. No mean/median/legacy interchange; line tie abstains for strict point.
products.law: Explicit support/weights/CDF parameterization with exact appearance/push/event semantics. Saved crossing probability may transfer only to identical threshold/event/conditioning. leaf_ids alone require safe retained support/model/query binding.
products.event: Anytime rushing-or-receiving TD >=1, excludes passing/return TD. No invented NO market.
products.chart: Exact nick-chart-ppr-v1 component completeness/zero semantics; generic Sleeper fpts incompatible.

adapters: Per-record immutable code/hash/query bindings in shortlists/QB_CANDIDATES_V1.json, QB_COMPONENTS_V1.json and OTHER_CANDIDATES_V1.json, with typed-body/V3 law qualification supplements. They are not a newly fitted exporter.
coverage: Keep all3474 cases; mark each arm unavailable/fallback/native/unknown. Pair only compatible cases; never global all-candidate intersection. Existing historical accuracy does not establish frame availability.
selection: Reconstruct existing frozen own policies only from complete compatible forecast-time boards. Broad-side tables are not selected-list tests. New capacities/side rules require recipe freeze before grades. No forced fills.
missing_inference: Any necessary new origin inference or fit needs explicit earlier-only scope, safe model/source qualification and complete cost; this handoff grants none.
retention: Public-safe metadata/aggregate/code only; exact private bodies and canonical rows remain existing approved routes. No public C upload prerequisite.
